chunks: Say: "Then bring a Book from God which gives better guidance than these so that I may follow it, if you speak the truth."

key_terms.مِنْهُمَا: From among the two (referring to previous scriptures or options)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Bring a Book from God' in Surah Yasin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited as a proof of the Quran's completeness and finality, emphasizing that no subsequent revelation will supersede it. It underscores the concept of 'I'jaz' (inimitability), challenging humanity to produce a text with equal spiritual depth and guidance, thereby affirming the Quran's unique divine authority.
